options.name: cacert
options.description: File to load root certificates from

options.name: cache_dir
options.description: Set the cache directory

options.name: cleanup_cache
options.description: Auto remove old cache directories

options.name: compression
options.description: Compression mode

options.name: exclude_caches
options.description: Excludes cache directories that are marked with a CACHEDIR.TAG file

options.name: exclude_if_present
options.description: takes filename[:header], exclude contents of directories containing filename (except filename itself) if header of that file is as provided

options.name: exclude_larger_than
options.description: Max size of the files to be backed up (allowed suffixes: k/K, m/M, g/G, t/T)

options.name: exclude_patterns
options.description: List of patterns to exclude from backup

options.name: force
options.description: Force re-reading the target files/directories

options.name: group_by
options.description: Set grouping of snapshots

options.name: host
options.description: Set the hostname for the snapshot

options.name: iexclude_patterns
options.description: List of patterns to exclude from backup, case-insensitive

options.name: ignore_ctime
options.description: Ignore ctime changes when checking for modified files

options.name: ignore_inode
options.description: Ignore inode number changes when checking for modified files

options.name: insecure_tls
options.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to the repository

options.name: key_hint
options.description: Key to try decrypting first

options.name: no_cache
options.description: Do not use a local cache

options.name: no_lock
options.description: Do not lock the repository, allows some operations on read-only repositories

options.name: one_file_system
options.description: Don't cross filesystem boundaries and subvolumes

options.name: pack_size
options.description: Set target pack size in MiB

options.name: parent
options.description: Set parent snapshot

options.name: password
options.description: Password for repository

options.name: password_file
options.description: Path to file to read the repository password from

options.name: paths
options.description: Paths to backup

options.name: repository
options.description: Path to Restic repository

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags to apply to snapshot

options.name: time
options.description: Set time of the backup

options.name: tls_client_cert
options.description: Path to a file containing PEM encoded TLS client certificate and private key

options.name: with_atime
options.description: Store the atime for all files and directories
